51 /**
52 * @brief Network Interface unicast IP addresses
53 *
54 * Stores the unicast IP addresses assigned to this network interface.
55 */
56 struct net_if_addr {
57 /** IP address */
58 struct net_addr address;
59
60 /** Reference counter. This is used to prevent address removal if there
61 * are sockets that have bound the local endpoint to this address.
62 */
63 atomic_t atomic_ref;
64
65 #if defined(CONFIG_NET_NATIVE_IPV6)
66 struct net_timeout lifetime;
67 #endif
68
69 /** How the IP address was set */
70 enum net_addr_type addr_type;
71
72 /** What is the current state of the address */
73 enum net_addr_state addr_state;
74
75 #if defined(CONFIG_NET_NATIVE_IPV6)
76 #if defined(CONFIG_NET_IPV6_PE)
77 /** Address creation time. This is used to determine if the maximum
78 * lifetime for this address is reached or not. The value is in seconds.
79 */
80 uint32_t addr_create_time;
81
82 /** Preferred lifetime for the address in seconds.
83 */
84 uint32_t addr_preferred_lifetime;
85
86 /** Address timeout value. This is only used if DAD needs to be redone
87 * for this address because of earlier DAD failure. This value is in
88 * seconds.
89 */
90 int32_t addr_timeout;
91 #endif
92 #endif /* CONFIG_NET_NATIVE_IPV6 */

253 /** Network interface flags. */
254 enum net_if_flag {
255 /** Interface is admin up. */
256 NET_IF_UP,
257
258 /** Interface is pointopoint */
259 NET_IF_POINTOPOINT,
260
261 /** Interface is in promiscuous mode */
262 NET_IF_PROMISC,
263
264 /** Do not start the interface immediately after initialization.
265 * This requires that either the device driver or some other entity
266 * will need to manually take the interface up when needed.
267 * For example for Ethernet this will happen when the driver calls
268 * the net_eth_carrier_on() function.
269 */
270 NET_IF_NO_AUTO_START,
271
272 /** Power management specific: interface is being suspended */
273 NET_IF_SUSPENDED,
274
275 /** Flag defines if received multicasts of other interface are
276 * forwarded on this interface. This activates multicast
277 * routing / forwarding for this interface.
278 */
279 NET_IF_FORWARD_MULTICASTS,
280
281 /** Interface supports IPv4 */
282 NET_IF_IPV4,
283
284 /** Interface supports IPv6 */
285 NET_IF_IPV6,
286
287 /** Interface up and running (ready to receive and transmit). */
288 NET_IF_RUNNING,
289
290 /** Driver signals L1 is up. */
291 NET_IF_LOWER_UP,
292
293 /** Driver signals dormant. */
294 NET_IF_DORMANT,
295
296 /** IPv6 Neighbor Discovery disabled. */
297 NET_IF_IPV6_NO_ND,
298
299 /** IPv6 Multicast Listener Discovery disabled. */
300 NET_IF_IPV6_NO_MLD,
301
302 /** Mutex locking on TX data path disabled on the interface. */
303 NET_IF_NO_TX_LOCK,
304
305 /** @cond INTERNAL_HIDDEN */
306 /* Total number of flags - must be at the end of the enum */
307 NET_IF_NUM_FLAGS
308 /** @endcond */
309 };

311 /** @brief Network interface operational status (RFC 2863). */
312 enum net_if_oper_state {
313 NET_IF_OPER_UNKNOWN, /**< Initial (unknown) value */

315 NET_IF_OPER_DOWN, /**< Interface is down */
316 NET_IF_OPER_LOWERLAYERDOWN, /**< Lower layer interface is down */
317 NET_IF_OPER_TESTING, /**< Training mode */
318 NET_IF_OPER_DORMANT, /**< Waiting external action */
319 NET_IF_OPER_UP, /**< Interface is up */
320 } __packed;

626 /**
627 * @brief Network traffic class.
628 *
629 * Traffic classes are used when sending or receiving data that is classified
630 * with different priorities. So some traffic can be marked as high priority
631 * and it will be sent or received first. Each network packet that is
632 * transmitted or received goes through a fifo to a thread that will transmit
633 * it.
634 */
635 struct net_traffic_class {
636 /** Fifo for handling this Tx or Rx packet */

639 #if NET_TC_COUNT > 1 || defined(CONFIG_NET_TC_TX_SKIP_FOR_HIGH_PRIO) \
640 || defined(CONFIG_NET_TC_RX_SKIP_FOR_HIGH_PRIO)
641 /** Semaphore for tracking the available slots in the fifo */
642 struct k_sem fifo_slot;
643 #endif
644
645 /** Traffic class handler thread */
646 struct k_thread handler;
647
648 /** Stack for this handler */
649 k_thread_stack_t *stack;
650 };

660 /**

664 * There can be many net_if_dev instance against the same device.

667 * to a network context: it then makes the relation with a network context

671 * network interface, each net_if_dev should be instantiated by one of the

2948 /* used to ensure encoding of checksum support in net_if.h and

2951 #define NET_IF_CHECKSUM_NONE_BIT 0
2952 #define NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_HEADER_BIT BIT(0)
2953 #define NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_ICMP_BIT BIT(1)
2954 /* Space for future protocols and restrictions for IPV4 */
2955 #define NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_HEADER_BIT BIT(10)
2956 #define NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_ICMP_BIT BIT(11)
2957 /* Space for future protocols and restrictions for IPV6 */

2959 #define NET_IF_CHECKSUM_UDP_BIT BIT(22)

2963 /**
2964 * @brief Type of checksum for which support in the interface will be queried.
2965 */
2966 enum net_if_checksum_type {
2967 /** Interface supports IP version 4 header checksum calculation */
2968 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_HEADER = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_HEADER_BIT,
2969 /** Interface supports checksum calculation for TCP payload in IPv4 */
2970 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_TCP = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_HEADER_BIT |
2971 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_TCP_BIT,
2972 /** Interface supports checksum calculation for UDP payload in IPv4 */
2973 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_UDP = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_HEADER_BIT |
2974 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_UDP_BIT,
2975 /** Interface supports checksum calculation for ICMP4 payload in IPv4 */
2976 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_ICMP = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV4_ICMP_BIT,
2977 /** Interface supports IP version 6 header checksum calculation */
2978 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_HEADER = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_HEADER_BIT,
2979 /** Interface supports checksum calculation for TCP payload in IPv6 */
2980 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_TCP = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_HEADER_BIT |
2981 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_TCP_BIT,
2982 /** Interface supports checksum calculation for UDP payload in IPv6 */
2983 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_UDP = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_HEADER_BIT |
2984 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_UDP_BIT,
2985 /** Interface supports checksum calculation for ICMP6 payload in IPv6 */
2986 NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_ICMP = NET_IF_CHECKSUM_IPV6_ICMP_BIT
2987 };

3486 #define NET_IF_INIT(dev_id, sfx, _l2, _mtu, _num_configs) \

3488 NET_IF_DEV_GET_NAME(dev_id, sfx)) = { \
3489 .dev = &(DEVICE_NAME_GET(dev_id)), \
3490 .l2 = &(NET_L2_GET_NAME(_l2)), \
3491 .l2_data = &(NET_L2_GET_DATA(dev_id, sfx)), \
3492 .mtu = _mtu, \
3493 .flags = {BIT(NET_IF_LOWER_UP)}, \
3494 }; \
3495 static Z_DECL_ALIGN(struct net_if) \
3496 NET_IF_GET_NAME(dev_id, sfx)[_num_configs] \
3497 __used __noasan __in_section(_net_if, static, \
3498 dev_id) = { \
3499 [0 ... (_num_configs - 1)] = { \
3500 .if_dev = &(NET_IF_DEV_GET_NAME(dev_id, sfx)), \
3501 NET_IF_CONFIG_INIT \
3502 } \
3503 }; \
3504 IF_ENABLED(CONFIG_NET_STATISTICS_VIA_PROMETHEUS, \
3505 (static PROMETHEUS_COLLECTOR_DEFINE( \
3506 NET_PROMETHEUS_GET_COLLECTOR_NAME(dev_id, \
3507 sfx), \
3508 net_stats_prometheus_scrape, \
3509 NET_IF_GET(dev_id, sfx)); \
3510 NET_STATS_PROMETHEUS(NET_IF_GET(dev_id, sfx), \
3511 dev_id, sfx);))

3516 .dev = &(DEVICE_NAME_GET(dev_id)), \
3517 .mtu = _mtu, \
3518 .l2 = &(NET_L2_GET_NAME(OFFLOADED_NETDEV)), \
3519 .flags = {BIT(NET_IF_LOWER_UP)}, \
3520 }; \
3521 static Z_DECL_ALIGN(struct net_if) \
3522 NET_IF_GET_NAME(dev_id, sfx)[NET_IF_MAX_CONFIGS] \
3523 __used __noasan __in_section(_net_if, static, \
3524 dev_id) = { \
3525 [0 ... (NET_IF_MAX_CONFIGS - 1)] = { \
3526 .if_dev = &(NET_IF_DEV_GET_NAME(dev_id, sfx)), \

3528 } \
3529 }; \

3778 #define NET_IFACE_COUNT(_dst) \
3779 do { \
3780 extern struct net_if _net_if_list_start[]; \
3781 extern struct net_if _net_if_list_end[]; \
3782 *(_dst) = ((uintptr_t)_net_if_list_end - \
3783 (uintptr_t)_net_if_list_start) / \
